data.name: Bhuwan
data.gender_notes: Bhuwan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhuwan is a name derived from Sanskrit language, which means 'Lord of the Earth'. In Hindu mythology, Bhuwan is one of the seven celestial worlds in the universe, ruled by the deity Lord Vishnu. It is the earthly world, where humans reside. The name Bhuwan carries the meaning “Lord of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhuwan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhuwan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Bhuwan holds significant spiritual meaning in Hinduism. It represents the idea that the physical world is not just a material existence, but a manifestation of the divine. The earth is revered as a living entity, and Bhuwan is a reminder of our connection to it as well as to the divine power that governs it. It encourages a sense of gratitude, respect, and appreciation for the earth and the divine force that sustains it.
